name: Zhizn'. Igra. Smert'.
source:
Viktor, a gambler and no-lifer, dreams of meeting a girl and not being single, but doesn't know how to do it. Unexpectedly, he receives an invitation to beta test a new game - a sophisticated dating sim. Soon he meets a girl in real life. Everything goes well at first
however, real-life events turn out to be mystically connected to the game.

[Translated from [url=https://tecquo.itch.io/life-game-death]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
维克多是一名赌徒和无生命的人，他梦想着遇到一个女孩并且不再单身，但不知道该怎么做。出乎意料的是，他收到了测试一款新游戏的邀请——一款复杂的约会模拟游戏。很快他在现实生活中遇到了一个女孩。一开始一切都很顺利
然而，现实生活中的事件却与游戏有着神秘的联系。

[译自[url=https://tecquo.itch.io/life-game-death]Itch.io[/url]]
